subject.title: [Feature]: Audio file support in read tool (multimodal parity with images)

question: Should OpenClaw add native audio attachments to the core read-tool contract, and what raw-media egress, fallback, and session/audit policy should govern that path?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the solution changes sensitive local media forwarding, provider capability routing, and session transcript semantics that automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Design the native-audio contract first
options.body: Settle typed audio blocks, provider transport, explicit raw-media egress, payload limits, unsupported-model behavior, and transcript/audit metadata before implementation.

options.title: Keep audio transcription-only for now
options.body: Leave raw audio out of the read tool and direct users to existing STT/media-understanding paths until maintainers are ready to own native audio egress.

options.title: Fold into the broader native-audio tracker
options.body: Treat this read-tool request as a subcase of issue #51667 if maintainers want one product design thread for native audio.

recommendation.title: Design the native-audio contract first
recommendation.body: Settle typed audio blocks, provider transport, explicit raw-media egress, payload limits, unsupported-model behavior, and transcript/audit metadata before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest feature-history signal across media understanding and the product/security boundary this decision would change.
